nonUsConfiguration.title: Gender & Fair Employment Regulations (Northern Ireland)
nonUsConfiguration.instructions: Please provide your gender and religion. In addition to our Talent Acquisition Privacy Statement available on Stryker careers site, please note that according to the Fair Employment (Monitoring) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1999 Stryker is obliged to provide the Equality Commission for Northern Ireland with anonymized data on our applicant´s and employee´s community background and sex. If you decide not to provide this  information we may have to make a determination based on information already supplied by you. This is known as the residuary method. We would encourage you to answer these questions. Your answers will be used by us to prepare and submit a monitoring return to the Equality Commission which we are legally required to submit. Your identity will be kept anonymous and your answers will be treated with the strictest confidence. We assure you that your answers will not be used by us to make any decisions affecting you, whether in a recruitment exercise or during the course of employment with us: your response to this question will be available only to a restricted group of HR administrative roles, excluding participants in your recruitment process. This process is a legal requirement and is compliant with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
